PR: Allow crossplane to merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs [closed]
### Description of your changes

Merge desired to existing MRD spec in the API Establisher.

This ensures that the APIEstablisher never inadvertently changes MRD states except when explicitly setting them to Active, maintaining the principle that MRD state management is controlled externally.

Fixes https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/issues/6684
